corrections: CASE_WORK_UNCOVERED: 58 of the 59 name the seed contractor a1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001. The uncovered line is dated inside the case window after the seed work was cleared, and run 3 (35940435661) proved for 26 cases that the case itself created it; for the others the attribution to the case fixture is inferred from the run 2 blocker text, not proven.

"none turned into FAIL" does not show that the oracles held: the trial group records every Python exception of a case, oracle assertions included, as INCOMPLETE. What the runs show is that each moved case stopped where the engine answered BLOCKED; its later assertions were not reached.

The quieting of this run posted OFF attendance and approved seed payrolls with the books reopened to 2026-01-01, then put the closing date back with the administrative helper and a hard-coded 2026-08-31, checking the engine only from 09-01. Run 4 reads the closing date, quiets the whole reopened range and requires READY for it.
